Mold frontmatter cites this schema via [[test-data-refs]] wiki-links; the cast pipeline imports the `testDataRefsSchema` runtime export and serializes it into cast bundles. $defs.Fixture is a verbatim copy of the galaxy-workflow-test-plan Fixture; a test keeps them equal.
title: Galaxy workflow test-data refs
description: Test data for each Galaxy workflow input, written by the test-data-resolution chain (a source-specific Mold, then find-test-data) and read by implement-galaxy-workflow-test. One ref per workflow input; an input no leg could resolve stays in the list as an honest gap, and an optional one the test leaves unset as an omitted ref.

refs.description: One entry per workflow input label. A later leg of the chain keeps every entry an earlier leg resolved, unchanged, and replaces only unresolved ones.

workflow_label.description: Workflow input this ref feeds: its label in the Galaxy interface brief, or its input port in the CWL design.

collection_shape.description: Galaxy collection shape when the input is a collection, e.g. list, paired, list:paired, record; null for a single dataset.

datatype.description: Galaxy datatype/extension, e.g. fastqsanger.gz, fasta, tabular; null when undecided.

resolved.description: true when the ref points at real data of the required shape; false for an honest gap, or for an omitted input.

omitted.description: true for an optional input the test leaves unset after every leg came up empty. It is settled, not a gap, but carries no data, so resolved stays false. Only for an input the interface marks optional; the refs cannot check that themselves.

resolved_by.description: Name of the Mold that resolved, or omitted, this input, e.g. nextflow-to-test-data or find-test-data; null for a gap.

reason.description: Why the input is unresolved or omitted; null when resolved.

fixture.description: Where the data lives. For a collection whose elements carry their own fixtures, storage and location may be null.

elements.description: Collection elements, nested for nested shapes (list:paired → sample → forward/reverse). Identifiers must match the staged test file.

prep.description: Data-import-boundary prep needed to reach the Galaxy shape from the source data: a subset, split, or concatenation. A note on the ref, not an analysis step.

DataElement.description: An element of a resolved collection: it carries a located fixture, or nested elements that each do.

storage.description: Where the fixture data lives or should live: remote-url (Zenodo/EBI/SRA location), in-repo (committed test-data path), cvmfs-string (data-table/built-in-index bare string), generated-toy (to be synthesized), or unresolved (not yet sourced).

location.description: Concrete URL, repo-relative path, or data-table string when known; null when the fixture still needs resolution.

checksum.description: Integrity hash when available, e.g. SHA-1:<hex>; null when unknown.

provenance.description: Where this fixture comes from or how it was chosen, e.g. a translated source test-data reference, a Zenodo record, or a note that test-data-resolution must supply it.
